question: **Select the sentence which does NOT have a spelling error.**

options.text: Tipu Sultan, the ruler of Mysore introduced eukalyptus in India to enhance the beauty of his garden in the 18th century.
Tipu Sultan, the ruler of Mysore introduced eucaliptus in India to enhance the beauty of his garden in the 18th century.
Tipu Sultan, the ruler of Mysore introduced eualyptus in India to enhance the beauty of his garden in the 18th century.
Tipu Sultan, the ruler of Mysore introduced eucalyptus in India to enhance the beauty of his garden in the 18th century.

solution:
The correct answer is '**Tipu Sultan, the ruler of Mysore introduced eucalyptus in India to enhance the beauty of his garden in the 18th century.**'
